question: The ninth five year plan of India was launched in ____________
solution: The correct answer is __**1997**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Ninth Five-Year Plan** of India was launched in the year **1997** and covered the period from **1997 to 2002**. • This plan was formulated under the leadership of the then Prime Minister, **Inder Kumar Gujral**, and later implemented during the tenure of **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**. • The Ninth Five-Year Plan aimed at achieving a growth rate of **6.5%**, with a focus on **inclusive growth** and reducing poverty. • Its primary objectives included **poverty alleviation, employment generation, infrastructure development**, and promoting **self-reliance** in the economy. • This plan emphasized the importance of the **private sector** while maintaining a strong role for the **public sector**, fostering a balanced and sustainable growth model.
